## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (and `npm run e2e` still passes if you touched the UI or the overlay)
- [ ] User-facing text went into `src/shared/i18n/en/`
- [ ] The commit messages are conventional (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...), since release-please builds the changelog from them
